dedupe_keys.name: effects of hydrogen jet fires on the erosion of tunnel road materials and lining materials

description: The Health and Safety Executive publishes high-pressure hydrogen jet-fire experiments relevant to vehicle pressure-relief devices. Zenodo provides Excel results, videos and metadata documentation free under CC BY 4.0. Tests compare releases from a 700-bar system through 2.1-millimetre and 0.57-millimetre openings, including interaction with concrete and tarmac surfaces. These observations can calibrate fire and surface-damage components in hydrogen-vehicle infrastructure risk simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this experimental package. Coverage is the stated laboratory release arrangements, not all tank, ventilation or installation conditions. Scaling to another pressure-relief design requires attention to geometry and boundary conditions. Exact channel definitions, repeated-test uncertainty and damage measurements were not independently checked. No workbook, video or document was downloaded and no fire model was validated.
